compatibility.description: NO RXA outdoor pairing is evidenced for the 15-class on p.42: the UNITÉS EXTÉRIEURES table columns are 20A9/25A9/35A9/42B/50B only (no 15-class outdoor column), and the 15-class efficiency column header is 'CTXA15AW/BS/BT/BB' WITHOUT a '+ RXA' suffix (unlike 20..50 which read '20AW/BS/BT/BB + 20A9' etc). The vertical merged band 'Possibilité de connexion uniquement aux unités extérieures multi' also spans the table. Do NOT assume a 15-class monosplit outdoor pairing; combination scheme pending.

evidence.locator: PDF p.42 (printed 42), 'Données relatives à l'efficacité' column header 'CTXA15AW/BS/BT/BB' (no '+ RXA' suffix) + UNITÉS EXTÉRIEURES header 'RXA 20A9 25A9 35A9 42B 50B' (no 15 column) + vertical merged caveat band 'Possibilité de connexion uniquement aux unités extérieures multi'
